description: This file is a shell script for testing the integration of git with Subversion (svn), including initializing repositories, fetching branches, handling directory moves, deletions, and more. It contains test cases that automate svn operations and validate the correct behavior of git-svn.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: A method to execute svn commands, typically wrapping svn CLI operations.

methods.name: poke
methods.description: A method used to update or touch files in the working directory, likely triggering git-svn refresh.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A function to define a test case that expects success, runs commands, and validates outcomes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: A function to mark the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: A utility to get the object id (size) of a git blob.
